validationNotes: Actual runtime data nameKey9476→9477. One complete Kengren Start canonical ID dm32-101, with three equivalent official print aliases dm32-101HC/dmc64-042/dmex18-067. All4 full pages and images, Fire2/1000/FlameMonster/mana1/current limit4 verified. Family search11 results checked, only exact wave-equivalent name4 prints included. Reprints never counted as new names.

Native g439Tap plus GoukenEvolution1362 whole-deck private look, optional any card whose name includes OneKengren, atop source, followed by shuffle. Paid2/fresh sickness, beyond7 cards, two actual next evolution creatures, optional decline/no match, Q.Q.QX look/shuffle lock, ignored/sealed/tapped source, disappeared or sealed source before selection tested both seats. Physical cards conserved and no extra evolution mana cost.

Exact official QA39412 reproduced both seats: Start tap-search evolves actual FullSpeed under actual MomoFortress and enters untapped. Without Fortress inherited tapped state retained. Pending inspection survives encrypted JSON, only actor sees whole-deck inspection/actions, opponent hidden names excluded, AI reads pure. Original plus all reprint deck IDs resolve without changing input saved rows; legal40/80-card format and JSON continuations preserved.

Official DMEX18 HTML uses U301C wave dash while original uses UFF5E. Added explicit wave-dash-only verification evidence to this print. Verification-only guard folds those glyphs for complete basic-field comparison; strict full-face ability pins, official source ID, image SHA, current limit and all unchanged catalogue rows still required. Existing unsupported catalogue print ID dmex18-067 preserved and alias-added only with its exact official row name. Runtime nameKey, canonical-name aliases, IDs and saved schemas unchanged. Negative tests reject absent flag, different name, changed cost/power/type/ability, missing image/source/restriction.

Initial test assumptions corrected: dmex18-067 is an existing unsupported catalogue row, so verified wave-only evidence must safely permit an alias without replacing that row. Q.Q.QX forbids shuffle as well as look, so expected unchanged RNG under the actual lock; decline/no-match otherwise shuffle. No gameplay code change required. All final focused/related tests, npm run check, audit, target9500 and existing-definition invariants pass.

G.O.D. held because native normal evolution matcher lacks exact cost9 restriction despite invasion support. CavalierShark and Yabasugiru remain held for complete shared-path requirements. Historical registered verification, reprint and interrupted long-test pending retained exactly; full npm test not rerun. No push/Pages/Netlify.
